messages:
Tara (Eng Manager): Quick follow-up from today's All-Hands Q&A: clarify please  are we locking majors to a biweekly ship window or just recommending it? Need wording for team docs.
Sam (VP Eng): Leadership decision: majors go on a biweekly cadence (predictable windows). Minors/hotfixes can go anytime. Goal: predictability for customers and reduced last-minute rush.
Priya (Product): For PMs: I'll add a checklist field 'release_criticality' to mark API/storage/billing-affecting work as major. Will share a decision table.
Omar (SRE): Operational notes: oncall handoff stays same headcount but release week includes an "active verification" shift for one rotation. Canary minimum 4h, post-rollout watch 48h. Will update runbooks.
Lena (QA): Proposed quality gates for majors: all critical tests green, no unresolved critical bugs, regression delta <3% on top-200 prompts. I'll prepare a 1-pager QA checklist and a sample runner command.
Ivy (Eng Ops): Action items from thread: 1) ticket fields (release_type, freeze_date, rollback_contact) 2) customer notice template 3) post-release checklist. I'll own 1 & 2.
Rohan (Platform): Note for Dedicated customers: we must offer maintenance windows and 72h heads-up. If a customer opts out, we queue them for the next window. Ops to handle comms.
deploy-bot: "Planned: canary 8% at 16:00 UTC -> 25% over 45m. Monitoring: p95/p99, error-rate, memory. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 0.4% or p99 > baseline*1.35"
Tara (Eng Manager): @Lena can you paste the quick regression command so teams can copy into their release tickets?
Lena (QA): Sure, rough snippet: ```
# quick_regress.sh
python eval/run_regression.py --prompts top200.txt --baseline baseline_v3.json --candidate build_456 --max_regression 0.03
```
I'll add the full harness link in Confluence.
Eli (Customer Success): We'll prepare a short customer-facing blurb: "Planned maintenance during major releases; brief impact possible during rollout; we provide rollback and post-release report." Ops please share draft.
Sam (VP Eng): Leadership asks: keep majors predictable, minimise customer impact, and keep hotfixes fast. Please finalize docs by EOW so we can pilot next cycle.
Ivy (Eng Ops): Owners summary: Ivy (ticket fields + customer blurb), Lena (QA checklist + harness), Omar (runbook + canary wiring), Priya (PM decision table), Rohan (Dedicated comms). I'll schedule a 30m sync Friday to sign-off.
Tara (Eng Manager): Thanks all  closing thread  will post the RFC link after the Friday sync.
